name: io.github.ashfordeOU/kshana-mcp
title: Kshana PNT-resilience simulator
description: Run the validated Kshana PNT-resilience simulator (orbits, frames, GNSS, fusion) from an AI agent.

environmentVariables.name: KSHANA_MCP_IQ_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder the GNSS IQ tools (iq_scene, iq_acquire, iq_track, iq_frontend, iq_info, iq_campaign, iq_campaign_status) may read and write; every IQ path argument is relative to it. Unset leaves the IQ file tools off; the other tools are unaffected. In a container, mount a volume and point this at it.

environmentVariables.name: KSHANA_MCP_IQ_MAX_SAMPLES
environmentVariables.description: Most complex samples one IQ call may generate or process (default 50000000).
